title: NamedRootState accepts unknown fields wherever it is decoded
outcome: NamedRootState accepts unknown fields wherever it is decoded
acceptance: Decoding a NamedRootState with a field its variant does not name is refused rather than dropped, on every path that decodes it, with a test per variant (serde's deny_unknown_fields is not enforced on the unit variant of an internally tagged enum, so a variant-aware check is needed)

completion.summary: Landed 7d43c42: NamedRootState has one variant-aware decoder (src/domain/control/named_root_state.rs); each state takes exactly its own fields, and unknown, cross-variant and repeated keys are refused on every decode path, while serialization stays derived. ObservationRootBasis drops its local strict decoder. Tests cover each variant, the nested containers and stored begin-receipt replay. The copy audit of all 4 live stores refused 0, the negative control caught 6/6, and readiness was ready on all 4. Installed build fa3879cba444, exe sha256 4004c5fa…09a8.
